# Overview

This is a direct port of the retail **[RCLootCouncil](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil)** addon with certain elements modified to fit within the Classic environment. This means this version can always be (mostly) up to date with the latest features added to the main addon. For the retail version and description, see the original **[RCLootCouncil](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil)** addon.

### Wiki

The [RCLootCouncil Wiki](https://github.
com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/wiki) contains all the information you may need to use the addon, along with examples of specific use cases and is up to date with the Classic version. Do check it out!

### Bugtracking

Create an issue [here on Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-classic/issues/create) , and make sure to follow the description.

### Support

Head on over to the [RCLootCouncil Discord](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=http%253a%252f%252fdiscord.rclootcouncil.com%252f) if you have any questions. I rarely read Curseforge comments!

### 3rd Party Modules

* [EPGP Classic - RCLootCouncil Extension](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/epgp-classic-rclootcouncil-extension) by [rocket\_23](https://www.curseforge.com/members/gt_rocket/projects) _( [Retail](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/epgp-rclootcouncil-extension) | [Classic](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/epgp-classic-rclootcouncil-extension) )_

[Lint](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager) [Release](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager/releases) [Issues](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager/issues) [Discord](https://discord.gg/Qjn8KdD8yt) [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/classiclootmanager)

Be sure to read before upgrading to v2.0.0

# About

Classic Loot Manager is a robust Loot Tracking and awarding tool for guilds.
It's designed to superseed old DKP and EPGP AddOns and it's derivatives and solves it's biggest painpoints by focusing on optimial communication and storage. CLM implements Event Sourcing and MVC programming models to achieve those targets. All data is synchronised automatically.

Be sure to check our [Wiki](https://github.com/CoreLootManager/CoreLootManager/wiki) for lots of information.

Home Addon Browse [GitHub](https://github.com/zeddic/webdkp) Join 

World of Warcraft Addon

The in-game Addon lets you view and award DKP in World of Warcraft.It also allows you to
track raid attendance.It comes with a Sync program that uploads your information to the site with a single click. To fully make use of the addon,
you'll need to create a free account on WebDKP.com  
  
  
( Release Notes | More Screenshots )  
  
    
  
## Addon Features

* Integration with WebDKP.com
* View, Sort, and Filter your DKP table In-Game
* Add Awards and Items in Game
* Visual Award Log
* In Game Synching of Data
* Automated Bidding Support
* Timed Awards
* Zerosum DKP Support
* Attendance Tracking
* Auto Award for Boss Kills
* Customizable Options and Announcements
* Sync your in game table with WebDKP.com to manage your data and share it with others
* Start of EPGP Support

  
## Listing of changes for 4.0

\- Compatibility update for WoW Classic

Raid Leadership · World of Warcraft · 7 min read

# WoW Loot Systems: DKP, EPGP, Loot Council, and What Actually Works

Every WoW guild eventually fights about loot. This is the working comparison of DKP, EPGP, Loot Council, and Wishlist systems - what each actually rewards, what each silently punishes, and how to pick the one your roster won't quit over.

edit\_note By Jade Finch calendar\_today May 3, 2026 history Updated June 7, 2026

rocket\_launch Leading WoW players? [Build your guild site free →](https://guildorder.com/register?utm_source=guides&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=loot-systems-dkp-vs-epgp)

There is no neutral loot system.
Every system rewards a behavior, punishes another behavior, and has a drama vector hiding in week ten of progression. The guilds that survive a full tier without a loot blowup didn't pick the "fair" system; they picked the one their roster's culture was honest enough to support. This guide is the working comparison of the four systems modern guilds actually run, what each one is biased toward, and how to choose without rebuilding the matrix mid-tier. WoW Classic guilds run a different set - soft-reserve, GDKP, and 40-man DKP - covered in the WoW Classic loot-systems guide .

lightbulb

Who this is for

Officers picking or replacing a loot system. Raid leaders who keep getting dragged into loot disputes. Trial members trying to understand why their guild does loot the way it does. Applies to Heroic and Mythic raiding; LFR uses Personal Loot and rarely needs an officer-managed system.

## The four systems people actually run

Modern WoW guilds run one of four systems.

...

Loot Council and Wishlist treat new raiders fairly by default.
5. ### What's your average raid roster turnover?
   
   High turnover guilds (>30% per tier) should run EPGP or Wishlist; the system has to absorb new raiders without manual rebalancing. Low-turnover guilds can run DKP or Loot Council without churn pain.

## Addon and tooling reality

Every system above has at least one mature addon. The administrative overhead is in officer training, not the addon.

DKP
    Core Loot Manager (CLM) is the current default in 2025-2026 Classic raiding and supports DKP, EPGP, and roll modes from a single config. MonolithDKP and CommunityDKP still work but most active guilds have migrated off them.

EPGP
    EPGP Lootmaster (classic) or RCLootCouncil with EPGP module (retail). Wowaudit can drive automatic decay and import.

Loot Council
    RCLootCouncil. Universal. Add the wowaudit integration for sim data, alts, and historical context inline at award time.
